text_block_list.text: As one who shoulders the legacy of my grandmother and mother, this result was only natural.
choice_data_list: Let's stay focused for the next race too.

To stack up even more victories,

text_block_list.text: The reporters are waiting outside, so if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I hereby declare that I will put my life on the line to consistently deliver absolute results.
